settings.editor:
Welcome to RV PU College, Mysuru, where our mission is to provide a positive learning environment that encourages students to reach their full potential.

We are a pre-university college, offering comprehensive education for young adults to prepare for their university studies. Our college provides an excellent learning environment with experienced and knowledgeable faculty, modern facilities and abundant resources. We strive to provide our students with the best academic and personal growth opportunities, so that they can become well-rounded and successful individuals.

settings.editor:
We have opened doors to learning across Bengaluru, with campuses thoughtfully located to bring quality education closer to you. Each branch carries the same commitment to academic excellence, holistic growth and a student-first environment, yet each has a unique culture shaped by its community and surroundings.

Whether you seek an energetic academic hub, a calm learning atmosphere or a space that balances creativity and discipline, you’ll find a campus that feels just right. Explore our centres, learn what makes them special and choose the environment that empowers you to grow, achieve and thrive.

From academic achievements and cultural celebrations to sports victories, student-led initiatives and inspiring guest sessions, our campus is always alive with energy, creativity and talent. Dive into the experiences that define student life at RVPU Mysuru.

      const m = getMetrics();
      const slideTrans = animate
        ? 'width 520ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), min-width 520ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), max-width 520ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), margin-top 520ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)'
        : 'none';

      allSlides.forEach(function(s, idx) {
        s.classList.remove('mysuru-event-pos-0', 'mysuru-event-pos-1', 'mysuru-event-pos-2', 'mysuru-event-pos-3', 'mysuru-event-pos-4');
        const rel = idx - currentIndex;
        let w = m.sideW;
        let mt = '0em';

        if (m.mode === 'mobile') {
          if (rel === 0) s.classList.add('mysuru-event-pos-2');
          else s.classList.add('mysuru-event-pos-0');
        } else if (m.mode === 'tablet') {
          if (rel === 0) {
            s.classList.add('mysuru-event-pos-1');
            mt = '1.5em';
          } else if (rel === 1) {
            s.classList.add('mysuru-event-pos-2');
            w = m.centerW;
          } else if (rel === 2) {
            s.classList.add('mysuru-event-pos-3');
            mt = '1.5em';
          } else {
            s.classList.add('mysuru-event-pos-0');
          }
        } else {
          if (rel >= 0 && rel <= 4) {
            s.classList.add('mysuru-event-pos-' + rel);
          } else {
            s.classList.add((Math.abs(idx) % 2 === 0) ? 'mysuru-event-pos-0' : 'mysuru-event-pos-1');
          }
          if (rel === 2) {
            w = m.centerW;
          }
          // Exact 45px (2.8125em) downward offset on inner side panels (rel === 1 and rel === 3)
          if (rel === 1 || rel === 3) {
            mt = '2.8125em';
          }
        }

        s.style.transition = slideTrans;
        s.style.width = w + 'px';
        s.style.minWidth = w + 'px';
        s.style.maxWidth = w + 'px';
        s.style.marginRight = m.gapPx + 'px';
        s.style.marginTop = mt;
        s.style.flexShrink = '0';
        s.style.boxSizing = 'border-box';
      });

      wrapper.style.transition = animate ? 'transform 520ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)' : 'none';
      const offset = -(currentIndex * m.step);
      wrapper.style.transform = 'translate3d(' + offset + 'px, 0, 0)';
      syncDots();
    }
    wrapper._mysuruEventsRefresh = function() { applyClasses(false); };

    function nextSlide() {
      if (isAnimating) return;
      isAnimating = true;
      currentIndex += 1;
      applyClasses(true);
    }

    function prevSlide() {
      if (isAnimating) return;
      isAnimating = true;
      currentIndex -= 1;
      applyClasses(true);
    }

    wrapper.addEventListener('transitionend', function(e) {
      if (e.target !== wrapper) return;
      isAnimating = false;
      if (currentIndex >= 2 * N) {
        currentIndex -= N;
        applyClasses(false);
      } else if (currentIndex < N) {
        currentIndex += N;
        applyClasses(false);
      }
    });

    applyClasses(false);
    window.addEventListener('resize', function() { applyClasses(false); });

    const prevBtn = document.querySelector(prevSelector);
    const nextBtn = document.querySelector(nextSelector);
    if (prevBtn) {
      prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        prevSlide();
        resetTimer();
      });
    }
    if (nextBtn) {
      nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        nextSlide();
        resetTimer();
      });
    }

    dots.forEach(function(d, i) {
      d.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (isAnimating) return;
        const activeDot = (((currentIndex - N) % 4) + 4) % 4;
        const diff = i - activeDot;
        if (diff !== 0) {
          isAnimating = true;
          currentIndex += diff;
          applyClasses(true);
          resetTimer();
        }
      });
    });

    // Touch Swipe Support for Mobile & Tablet
    let touchStartX = 0;
    container.addEventListener('touchstart', function(e) {
      if (e.touches && e.touches.length) {
        touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
        clearInterval(timer);
      }
    }, { passive: true });
    container.addEventListener('touchend', function(e) {
      if (e.changedTouches && e.changedTouches.length) {
        const diff = e.changedTouches[0].clientX - touchStartX;
        if (Math.abs(diff) > 35) {
          if (diff < 0) nextSlide();
          else prevSlide();
        }
        resetTimer();
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    let timer = setInterval(nextSlide, 3000);
    function resetTimer() {
      clearInterval(timer);
      timer = setInterval(nextSlide, 3000);
    }
    container.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() { clearInterval(timer); });
    container.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() { resetTimer(); });
  }

  function initAll() {
    restorePlaceholderImages();
    const resultsFallback = [
      CDN + 'mysuru_topper_card_full.png',
      CDN + 'mysuru_topper_card_full.png',
      CDN + 'mysuru_topper_card_full.png',
      CDN + 'mysuru_topper_card_full.png',
      CDN + 'mysuru_topper_card_full.png',
      CDN + 'mysuru_topper_card_full.png',
      CDN + 'mysuru_topper_card_full.png',
      CDN + 'mysuru_topper_card_full.png',
      CDN + 'mysuru_topper_card_full.png',
      CDN + 'mysuru_topper_card_full.png'
    ];
    const eventsFallback = [
      CDN + 'mysuru_event_center.png',
      CDN + 'mysuru_event_center.png',
      CDN + 'mysuru_event_center.png',
      CDN + 'mysuru_event_center.png',
      CDN + 'mysuru_event_center.png',
      CDN + 'mysuru_event_center.png',
      CDN + 'mysuru_event_center.png',
      CDN + 'mysuru_event_center.png'
    ];
    setupResultsCarousel('.mysuru-results-carousel', '.mysuru-results-prev', '.mysuru-results-next', 5, 28, resultsFallback);
    setupEventsCarousel('.mysuru-events-carousel', '.mysuru-events-prev', '.mysuru-events-next', 18, eventsFallback);
    restorePlaceholderImages();
  }

  initAll();
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      initAll();
      setTimeout(initAll, 250);
      setTimeout(initAll, 700);
      setTimeout(initAll, 1500);
    });
  } else {
    setTimeout(initAll, 250);
    setTimeout(initAll, 700);
    setTimeout(initAll, 1500);
  }
  window.addEventListener('load', function() {
    initAll();
    setTimeout(initAll, 450);
    setTimeout(initAll, 1200);
  });
  if (typeof MutationObserver !== 'undefined' && document.body) {
    let debounceTimer = null;
    const obs = new MutationObserver(function() {
      if (debounceTimer) clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
      debounceTimer = setTimeout(restorePlaceholderImages, 150);
    });
    obs.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
  }
})();
</script>
